item.title: US stocks climb to their best day since the Iran war began after oil prices ease
item.description: NEW YORK — A drop in oil prices on Monday helped send the U.S. stock market to its best day since the war in Iran began.

item.title: Judge blocks US government from slimming down vaccine recommendations
item.description: A federal judge on Monday temporarily blocked federal health officials from cutting the number of vaccines recommended for every child, and said U.S. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. likely violated federal procedures in revamping a key vaccine advisory committee.

item.title: March Madness tips off Tuesday with First Four in Dayton
item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (AP) — March Madness tips off with the First Four, featuring one of this season’s best stories in Miami (Ohio) and a matchup of formerly embattled head coaches in Texas’ Sean Miller and NC State’s Will Wade.

item.title: Jets agree to trade quarterback Justin Fields to Chiefs to serve as Mahomes’ backup, AP source says
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — The New York Jets have agreed to a trade that will send quarterback Justin Fields to the Kansas City Chiefs, a person familiar with the deal told The Associated Press on Monday.

item.title: NBA owners will work on expansion again next week with Vegas and Seattle the targets, AP sources say
item.description: The NBA may move a step closer to adding teams in Seattle and Las Vegas next week when expansion — which has been a topic for some time — will again be discussed by the league’s board of governors, two people with knowledge of the matter told The Associated Press on Monday.

item.title: Defense sends Redeemer to state championship game
item.description: HAZLE TWP. — History wasn’t going to repeat itself Monday night.

item.title: Venezuela rallies past Italy 4-2 with 3-run 7th and will face US for World Baseball Classic title
item.description: MIAMI (AP) — Ronald Acuña Jr., Maikel Garcia and Luis Arraez hit run-scoring, two-out singles in a seventh-inning rally that led Venezuela over Italy 4-2 on Monday night and into its first World Baseball Classic championship game.

item.title: Opinion: Another regulatory issue for one, uniform internet: prediction markets
item.description: The chairman of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, an agency created to regulate the United States’ derivatives market, recently published a statement challenging states’ authority to regulate prediction markets and threatened to sue them.

item.title: Editorial: Citizenship-proof laws chase phantom fraud and threaten voters’ access
item.description: Always beware the Why not? argument — especially when it comes to erecting barriers to voting in elections. In that case, the pertinent question should always be, Why?
